Thanks for the remittance and the heads-up. We'll investigate the two value dates and the separate VAT line. Quick notes / asks from our side:

- Can you confirm the originating bank reference for the VAT line (the bank_notice_0915.png shows a different ref ending in "-VAT")?

Jonas —

Checked our AR ledger and payment queue. Summary of findings:

- RDW-2026-531 (USD 60,000.00) — fully applied on 2026-09-16. Posting reference: PAY-0916-7841.
- RDW-2026-532 (USD 60,000.00) — fully applied on 2026-09-16. Posting reference: PAY-0916-7842.
- VAT line (USD 8,400.00) — our bank feed created a separate unapplied receipt (BANK-VAT-0915) because the incoming reference didn't match either invoice. Our AR engine left it in unapplied cash / VAT-liability bucket.

I've attached payment evidence export. Recommend we:
1) Request the MT103 from Solstice that isolates the VAT transaction ref (to confirm payer intention).
2) If Solstice confirms VAT was intended as tax remittance linked to those invoices, we can post a journal to move BANK-VAT-0915 -> VAT payable and apply a contra to the two invoices so net invoice balances remain cleared.
3) If Solstice reports the VAT payment was for a different tax authority, we should keep it unapplied until clarified.

Attachments: payment_evidence_0915.pdf

Marcus — please prepare the reversing journal template and the two-line reclass so we can post once we have confirmation.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
